expectation_taxonomy.declared_design_distribution: 配置或设计明确声明的抽样分布、离散配额和参数分布；比较实现样本是否忠实于声明设计。
expectation_taxonomy.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: 给定输入后必须精确成立的身份、几何、公式、排序、聚合或守恒关系；比较数值误差与违例数。
expectation_taxonomy.model_internal_probability_expectation: 由当前软件响应模型给出的条件概率或 Monte Carlo 期望；比较软件实现、重复频率和代理是否吻合。
expectation_taxonomy.external_physical_expectation: 由独立试验、实测或经外部校准模型给出的物理/作战分布；当前项目在关键机制层未提供。

interpretation_rule: 前三类只能建立设计忠实性、软件一致性和模型内校准；只有第四类能够支持真实物理有效性。

stages.transform: 版本化 SimulationCase、Target、PhysicsRegistry、SamplingSpec、LabelSpec 与 split registry 绑定为一次可复现运行

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: 由冻结的 sampling spec、case budgets 与 split registry 声明；本层不重新定义概率分布。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: target/config/code/dependency/formal-input 哈希、案例数与身份必须精确一致。
expected_by_class.external_physical_expectation: not_applicable；本层是治理合同，不是物理验证。

requirements: formal input ordered identity exact match

stages.transform: 8 维 scrambled Sobol 潜变量映射为弹型、方向区域、方向坐标、瞄点、速度和滚转角

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: 8 维 Uniform(0,1) Sobol 设计；三个 profile 各 1/3；五个 approach region 各 1/5；区域内按立体角均匀；速度 Uniform(80,160) m/s。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: 一个冻结 Sobol 索引只能映射到一个候选身份；角色预算为 2000/300/300。
expected_by_class.model_internal_probability_expectation: not_applicable；该层产生输入设计，不使用响应概率。
expected_by_class.external_physical_expectation: missing；未提供真实来袭 profile、方向、速度或瞄点分布。

quantifiable_metrics: marginal KS distance without iid p-values

stages.transform: 候选按首次正向装甲交点合同进行 pre-outcome 拒绝/准入

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: 输入为 S01 的 P0；准入后 P_contact 是 P0 经确定性接触选择得到的条件/推送分布。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: 外部起点、有限非零速度、正向首次装甲交点、持久化接触与重算一致、姿态轴与速度一致、选择不读结果。
expected_by_class.model_internal_probability_expectation: 没有独立 Bernoulli 接触模型；准入率是确定性几何在 P0 下的经验测度。
expected_by_class.external_physical_expectation: missing；没有实测接触发生率或真实目标遭遇分布。

criteria: persisted first contact equals recomputed contact
expected_contract.analytic_distribution: not declared; P_contact is the deterministic push-forward/conditioning of P0 through target geometry

stages.name_zh: 首次装甲接触几何与模型输入
stages.transform: 正式工况保存首次命中点、法向、速度、姿态和撞击弹型，形成 16 维 first-armor-state 输入

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: profile、region、速度和姿态来自 P0 并经 S-CONTACT 条件化；无另行声明的闭式接触点密度。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: 距离/时间为正、法向单位化、命中点位于声明装甲、速度 80--160 m/s、方向指向表面内部、16 维编码与工况一致。
expected_by_class.model_internal_probability_expectation: not_applicable；该层是确定性几何与编码。
expected_by_class.external_physical_expectation: missing；无实测首次接触点、入射角、姿态和速度联合分布。

invariants: collision distance and time are positive
hit point lies on the declared first armor
impact direction points inward relative to the contact normal
profile is one of three frozen choices
expected_contract.conditional_distribution: induced by P0 plus S-CONTACT; no closed-form density is registered

quantifiable_metrics: hit-point and normal distribution by region/profile

stages.transform: 固定质量破片按 Taylor-Shapiro 环布局、2 度切平面高斯散布和 Gurney 圆筒初速生成

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: 按 profile 固定 total_count、单枚质量、ring_count 与 fragments_per_ring；环内方位均匀，Taylor-Shapiro 基准方向叠加切平面 Gaussian(0, 2 deg) 扰动。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: 每重复生成的破片数等于 profile total_count；Gurney 速度必须等于 G/sqrt(M_casing/M_charge+0.5)，并落入 [100,5000] m/s。基准速度为 small 2028.153764、medium 1974.946523、large 1875.608356 m/s。
expected_by_class.model_internal_probability_expectation: 方向随机性由 Taylor-Shapiro 环位置、环内均匀方位和 2 deg 切平面高斯共同定义；给定 profile 的初速是确定值而不是概率分布。
expected_by_class.external_physical_expectation: missing；profile 参数来自未保留的 legacy port，方向模型仅为 unverified literature-grounded candidate，Gurney/破片数量/质量未用独立试验校准。

comparison_items.metric: per-case absolute error and violation count

comparison_items.expected: Taylor-Shapiro ring + uniform azimuth per ring + tangent-plane Gaussian sigma=2 deg
comparison_items.metric: ring occupancy, angular residual mean/SD, circular-uniformity and distribution distance

stages.name_zh: 破片射线路径、遮挡与阻断
stages.transform: 每个破片先构造按距离排序的 target.ray_hits，再沿路径处理；未侵彻、残速耗尽或 OOD 事件终止后续路径

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: 由 S04 的方向模型与冻结 target geometry 诱导；无独立声明的可见率/遮挡率分布。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: 候选交点按距离排序；未侵彻、残速耗尽或 OOD 后不得出现下游已处理命中；processed hit 不得超过几何候选交点。
expected_by_class.model_internal_probability_expectation: 几何本身确定；随机侵彻分支会诱导下游可达概率，但项目未注册其解析闭式分布。
expected_by_class.external_physical_expectation: missing；无实测破片可见率、遮挡率或路径分布。

invariants: only processed contacts count as armor/component hits
a blocked ray cannot produce downstream observed hits

unavailable_metrics: geometry path length and hit-order distribution
stages.observability_reason: geometry_candidate_path, processed_path and blocking_reason are written only when capture_fragment_audit=true

stages.transform: 装甲接触经注册的 ballistic-limit/obliquity 模型采样侵彻结果，侵彻事件形成开孔并影响后续破片

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: 装甲材料、厚度与 demo_armor_response 参数由冻结 target/physics registry 声明；不构成经验物理分布。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: 每事件 v50、路径长度、残速、能量与开孔更新服从冻结公式；penetrations <= processed hits；开孔/复用计数由事件路径唯一决定。
expected_by_class.model_internal_probability_expectation: 适用域内单层事件 p=logistic(log(v/v50)/transition_width_ratio)，perforated 由同一随机 ballistic-limit 构造采样；理论上条件频率应匹配 penetration_probability。
expected_by_class.external_physical_expectation: missing；demo_armor_response 为 single-point software tuning，未以独立 V50/斜侵彻试验校准。

expected_contract.high_obliquity_policy: pathwise_monotone_ballistic_limit_lower_bound to 89.9 deg for certified nonperforation only

comparison_items.metric: event-level Brier/ECE/calibration-bin error or binomial frequency-minus-mean-p

comparison_items.expected: Monte Carlo push-forward of all event probabilities under path-dependent opening reuse
comparison_items.actual: mean penetrations / mean processed armor hits, stratified by profile/region

unavailable_metrics: event-level predicted penetration probability versus realized branch
event-level impact angle, v50 and penetration margin

stages.name_zh: 部件接触、侵彻与能量传递
stages.transform: 到达部件的破片记录命中、侵彻、到达速度、穿透裕度、沉积能量和损伤能量

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: 部件几何、材料、厚度、vulnerable_ratio 与 demo_component_response 参数由冻结 target/registry 声明。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: component penetrations <= component hits；0 <= residual energy <= incident energy；absorbed energy=incident-residual；damage energy 按 absorbed_plus_residual 权重生成。
expected_by_class.model_internal_probability_expectation: 适用域内部件 penetration_probability 使用注册 ballistic-limit logistic 响应；跨破片累计由 0.05 m complete-link 空间簇和生存概率乘积决定。
expected_by_class.external_physical_expectation: missing；部件 V50、能量传递权重、vulnerable_ratio 和空间相关长度无独立试验标定。

quantifiable_metrics: hit-conditioned log1p hit-count and energy distributions
unavailable_metrics: causal allocation of misses to occlusion versus nonpenetration

stages.transform: 高斜率无法被注册单侧边界解析的事件保留为 OOD；按部件传播最坏情形识别区间

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: not_applicable；该层由已发生事件及适用域政策诱导。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: 未解析事件不得转成未侵彻或零毁伤；受影响重复必须传播到部件和标签识别区间；epsilon-complete 阈值固定为 0.01。
expected_by_class.model_internal_probability_expectation: 识别区间给出当前模型在未解析分支下的最坏情形概率范围，不是概率先验。
expected_by_class.external_physical_expectation: missing；无高斜率侵彻/跳弹/破碎的外部结果分布。

rules: unresolved event is not converted to nonpenetration or zero damage
component-specific affected-replicate bounds with global fallback

actual_sources: dataset_v2 component identification intervals and masks

stages.transform: 每个重复将空间累计损伤能量映射为 degraded/failed 概率，再跨重复聚合

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: degraded: damage_energy_50=350 J, slope=3.0；failed: damage_energy_50=1900 J, slope=3.5；空间相关长度 0.05 m。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: 单簇原始响应为 vulnerable_ratio*logistic(slope*log(E/E50))；簇间按 1-product(1-p) 合并并作 ordinal projection；最终 0<=p_failed<=p_degraded<=1；跨重复算术平均。
expected_by_class.model_internal_probability_expectation: E=E50 时未乘 vulnerable_ratio 的 logistic 核为 0.5，实际孤立簇概率为 0.5*vulnerable_ratio；聚合状态是当前响应模型在重复随机性下的均值。
expected_by_class.external_physical_expectation: missing；E50、slope、vulnerable_ratio、空间累计与 ordinal projection 未经部件级独立毁伤试验校准。

invariants: point output is replicate arithmetic mean
domain-affected probability is represented by an identification interval

comparison_items.actual: replicate state probabilities are retained, but replicate cluster energies/locations are not retained in component_state_trace
comparison_items.metric: formula recomputation error when cluster trace exists; mean-state summaries are descriptive only because response is nonlinear

stages.transform: 冻结树对每个重复的联合部件状态求值，再对系统输出作算术平均；依赖场景并行保留

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: not_applicable；树是版本化逻辑结构，不是输入抽样设计。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: 对每个 replicate 的联合部件状态先求树，再对 32/8 个 replicate 输出作算术平均；禁止把均值部件概率先代入非线性树。
expected_by_class.model_internal_probability_expectation: 逐重复 tree output 的算术平均是当前模型下的 Monte Carlo 系统输出期望；Fréchet/条件独立场景给出声明依赖假设下的模型内范围。
expected_by_class.external_physical_expectation: missing；树仍为 provisional 且待 codebook confirmation，无系统级实测失效概率用于校准。

comparison_items.expected: evaluate tree on every replicate joint state, then arithmetic mean each system output
comparison_items.metric: per-case/per-output absolute recomputation error, maximum error, mismatch count

comparison_items.expected: replicate mean under the current provisional tree and software response model
comparison_items.metric: distribution by split/profile/region and Monte Carlo interval

stages.transform: 引擎聚合量转换为 p_hit、条件能量、条件命中数、p_degraded、p_failed、识别区间与任务掩码

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: not_applicable；标签分布由 S01--S10 的设计和模型推送得到。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: hurdle target v2 字段、log1p 变换、识别区间、epsilon=0.01 mask、至少两个 hit-positive replicate 条件与 sealed placeholder 必须精确执行。
expected_by_class.model_internal_probability_expectation: p_hit/p_degraded/p_failed 是当前软件教师的重复均值；条件能量/命中数只对 hit-positive replicate 定义。
expected_by_class.external_physical_expectation: missing；无实测部件命中、能量或毁伤标签分布。

expected_contract.mask_rule: probability identification interval width <= 0.01; conditional target also requires at least two hit-positive replicates and point identification

stages.transform: 案例、结果、表格和训练张量分片提交；设计权重、split 和身份被冻结并验证

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: 总数 2600，train/validation/test=2000/300/300；train R8、validation/test R32；冻结 sampling weights。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: shard/case/hash/role quota 精确一致；candidate group 和 realization 不跨 split；sealed test 零标签暴露。
expected_by_class.model_internal_probability_expectation: positivity、ESS fraction 与 weight CV 是设计质量量，不是物理概率验证。

expected_contract.leakage_requirement: no candidate group or realization crosses split

stages.name_zh: 快速期望代理与软件教师分布比较
stages.transform: FastSamplingProxy 的方向暴露、射线与侵彻期望同软件教师 replicate 均值比较

expected_by_class.declared_design_distribution: 代理与教师必须使用相同 train/validation 工况、profile/region 分层和冻结输入设计。
expected_by_class.deterministic_contract_or_conservation: 同工况身份、输出对齐、固定分箱和指标实现必须精确一致。
expected_by_class.model_internal_probability_expectation: 教师 replicate 均值是当前软件模型的比较目标；以 Brier/ECE/JS/W1/MMD2/false-unreached 衡量代理误差。
expected_by_class.external_physical_expectation: missing；代理—教师一致性不能替代破片、侵彻、能量、毁伤或系统失效的实测比较。

stages.interpretation_boundary: agreement with the current software teacher is not agreement with real physical or operational data

principal_observability_gaps.consequence: aggregate funnel rates are measurable, but per-fragment source, path, blocking, angle, probability and energy residuals cannot be reconstructed from the 2600-case archive

principal_observability_gaps.cause: P_contact is induced by deterministic geometry and reject/resample; no analytic density is registered
principal_observability_gaps.consequence: candidate-versus-selected empirical push-forward can be measured, but an absolute density-ratio error needs a high-resolution geometry reference or analytic Jacobian

principal_observability_gaps.cause: direction, munition, response and tree inputs remain unverified/provisional
principal_observability_gaps.consequence: the project can compare declared design distributions, deterministic contracts and model-internal probabilities with software realizations, but cannot estimate the distance to a real physical/operational distribution

principal_observability_gaps.cause: component_state_trace retains replicate state probabilities but not replicate component fragment metrics, cluster energies or impact locations
principal_observability_gaps.consequence: E50/log-slope software outputs are visible, but the nonlinear energy-to-state calculation cannot be exactly reconstructed from the formal archive; aggregate mean energy must not be substituted into the nonlinear response
